paper_title: Fixed-Parameter Algorithms for Unsplittable Flow Cover
classifications: Theory of computation → Packing and covering problems
Theory of computation → Fixed parameter tractability
statement: In this paper we presented a PAS for UFP-cover and showed that the problem is FPT under resource augmentation or if additionally the number of different task sizes are bounded by a parameter. It remains open whether the problem is FPT if only the number task sizes is bounded by a parameter, but not the number of tasks in the optimal solution. Also, we showed that UFP-cover is W [1]-hard. Our W [1]-hardness proof is based on a reduction from the k-subset sum problem, which can be solved in pseudopolynomial time O(nB). Hence, it is open whether UFP-cover is FPT if the input data are polynomially bounded. Our PAS can be simplified in this setting, however, it crucially relies on the slack obtained by selecting k additional tasks and thus does not solve the problem optimally in this case.
